integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the defining inequalities, polarity/complementary-dimension identities, and the explicit dimension-three open problem. The proof reduces candidate equality to principal-plane reflections of parallelotopes, computes those factors exactly as infinity-operator norms of Euclidean reflections, and proves that the required three equality normals cannot be orthonormal. An exact symbolic checker exhausts only the finite equality-type residue after the analytic reduction.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves strict pointwise nonattainment in dimension three but no uniform gap below sqrt(3). It is dimension-specific and uses the published three-dimensional Banach-Mazur equality classification as an input.
title: Nonattainment of the three-dimensional point-symmetric Minkowski-chirality bound
